_comment: The declared proof must fail with an AssertionError after the exact temporary mutation collapses the all-deleted branch into the generic empty branch.

expectedRed.testName: the real #1611 journey rejects collapsed all-deleted copy
expectedRed.why: The proof temporarily makes the all-deleted branch render the generic empty state, then runs the same @1611 Playwright journey. The journey must fail its visible 'Your organizations are no longer available' assertion; if the proof passes, the real journey no longer distinguishes all-deleted from never-invited or the mutation was not measured.
